items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15

ctx.x: Yeah. He never even make you ride the elephant, did he? No. Eh, Lizzie Mars said she was on the circus and she used to get on the elephant.
Yeah. Did she ever tell you that? I heard you talking about the song, yeah. Oh, Lizzie Mars kicks. Did your, uh, father teach you on both violin and clarinet? Yes. You see your...
I taught violin. You taught the clarinet by myself. We're probably talking about violin. Yeah, I taught the clarinet by myself.
